title: The '…' argument should be last in widget constructor invocations.
summary: Try moving the argument to the end of the argument list. Its category is flutter, style. It is stable since Dart 2.4.
message_templates: The '{}' argument should be last in widget constructor invocations.

title: Constructor declarations should be before non-constructor declarations.
summary: Try moving the constructor declaration before all other members. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: Constructor declarations should be before non-constructor declarations.

title: Dependencies not sorted alphabetically.
summary: Try sorting the dependencies alphabetically (A to Z). Its category is pub. It is stable since Dart 2.1.

title: Invalid location for the unnamed constructor.
summary: Try moving the unnamed constructor before all other constructors. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: Invalid location for the unnamed constructor.
